chunks: And Abu al-Hasan Musa ibn Ja'far, peace be upon them both, said:
Indeed, Allah, the Exalted, surely hates the servant who sleeps excessively. Indeed, Allah, the Exalted, surely hates the servant who is idle.

key_terms.الْفَارِغَ: one who is idle and without productive occupation

ai.seo_question: What does Imam Musa ibn Ja'far عليهما السلام say about excessive sleep and idleness?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that excessive sleep and idleness are blameworthy traits in a servant. It emphasizes diligence, purposeful living, and avoiding a life wasted in heedlessness and inactivity.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3635 - Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim (as) said:
"Indeed, Allah (swt) the Exalted hates a servant who sleeps excessively. Indeed, Allah (swt) the Exalted hates a servant who is idle."
